legal_trust.name: Mandatory Legal & Trust Foundation
legal_trust.description: Essential trust pages, explicit AdSense cookie disclaimers, GDPR/CCPA compliance, and contact transparency.

checks.name: Privacy Policy Page Presence
checks.adsense_specific_requirement: Must disclose third-party vendors (including Google) use cookies to serve ads based on user prior visits.

checks.name: Google AdSense & DoubleClick DART Cookie Clause
checks.adsense_specific_requirement: Mandatory clause informing visitors how to opt out of personalized advertising (e.g., aboutads.info or Google Ad Settings).

checks.name: Terms of Service / Terms of Use
Genuine About Us Page with Human E-E-A-T Credibility
Direct Contact Us Page (Email, Physical Location or Real Form)

content_eeat.name: Content Depth, Originality & E-E-A-T Quality
content_eeat.description: Prevention of 'Low Value Content' rejections. Enforces article volume, word counts, unique value, and anti-AI-spam signals.

checks.name: Indexable Substantial Article Volume
checks.description: Google manual reviewers require a fully fleshed-out publication before approving ad serving.

checks.name: In-Depth Article Substance (Word Count)
checks.description: Articles under 500 words trigger the automated 'Thin Content' penalty.

checks.name: Zero Generic AI Fluff / Templated Phrases
banned_ai_markers: in conclusion, it is important to remember
it is crucial to note that

checks.name: Proper Semantic Heading Hierarchy (H1, H2, H3)
checks.description: Content must be broken down logically with distinct subsections, lists, and structured data.

checks.name: Contextual Visual Media with Accessible Alt Text
checks.description: Articles should include relevant diagrams, screenshots, or royalty-free imagery with descriptive alt tags.

checks.name: Author Bylines and Editorial Attribution
checks.description: Every article must credit a named author with domain expertise or an editorial bio link.

technical_seo.name: Technical Crawlability & Web Health
technical_seo.description: Verification that Googlebot and Mediapartners-Google crawlers can parse and index the site without barriers.

checks.name: Active SSL / HTTPS Everywhere
checks.description: AdSense will not approve unencrypted HTTP websites.

checks.name: Robots.txt Crawlability (Googlebot & Mediapartners)
checks.description: Google AdSense ad auction crawlers (Mediapartners-Google) must not be restricted in robots.txt.

checks.name: Valid Accessible XML Sitemap
checks.description: Sitemap must be present at /sitemap.xml or referenced in robots.txt.

site_navigation_ux.name: Site Navigation, Architecture & User Experience
site_navigation_ux.description: Clear navigational taxonomy, working internal links, functional search, and zero broken or placeholder pages.

checks.name: Clear Primary Header Menu with Active Links
checks.description: Visitors must be able to navigate to all major categories with a maximum of 2 clicks.

checks.name: Footer Menu with Mandatory Legal Links
checks.description: Footer must link to Privacy Policy, Terms, About, and Contact.

checks.name: Absence of Dead Links & 404 Errors in Navigation
checks.description: No menu item should lead to a 404 page or '#'.

google_publisher_policy.name: Google Publisher Policies & Prohibited Niches
google_publisher_policy.description: Automated scanning for restricted categories, copyright infringement, deceptive downloads, and illegal content.

checks.name: No Deceptive Fake 'Download' or 'Play Now' Buttons
checks.description: AdSense prohibits layouts that trick users into clicking advertisements or fake call-to-actions.

checks.name: Absence of Unlicensed Streaming or File Downloads
checks.description: Hosting, linking to, or embedding pirated movies, music, or premium software is an immediate lifetime ban.

ad_layout_readiness.name: Ad Placement Ergonomics & Invalid Traffic Prevention
ad_layout_readiness.description: Preparation of ad slot geometry, ensuring ads do not overwhelm content or trigger accidental clicks.

checks.name: Content Superiority Ratio (Content > Ads)
checks.description: Content must be the prominent focus of every page; ads must not push content below the fold.

checks.name: Pre-Reserved Dimensions for Ad Units (CLS Prevention)
checks.description: Containers must prevent layout shifts when responsive ads load dynamically.

organic_footprint.name: Organic Search Footprint & Domain Maturity
organic_footprint.description: Signs of genuine search engine indexing, domain maturity, and organic traffic foundation.

checks.name: Google Indexability & Canonical Tags
checks.description: Pages must have valid canonical tags and meta robots allowing 'index, follow'.

checks.name: Schema.org Structured Data & Breadcrumbs
checks.description: Rich schema (Article, Organization, BreadcrumbList) provides strong E-E-A-T signals to Google.
